rootMotion: code-owned: the root joint is never animated and every clip plays in place

materialsUsed: approved P4-T3 brass-polished set bound by slot name at runtime and tinted by the manifest slot tint [0.8, 0.55, 0.75] (linear multiplier); gunmetal, warden-glow and warden-jewel (ruby, sapphire and emerald from COLOR_0) are factor-only
license: Original work generated in Blender from a checked-in script; concept reference from Paul's paid Higgsfield plan (Terms of Use 4.4)

checks: reimport gate (weights, influences, clips, root motion, bounds, sockets)
evaluated pose checks (floor, death on the floor, loop seams)

authorSelfScore.scorer: author self-score (the authoring agent; not the independent score create-rigged-character-assets requires)
gaps: The brass hue is unchanged: the front skirt still goes pale gold and the outer ring and back skirt cream under the key lights. The runtime replaces the brass slot with the shared brass-polished set (brass-aged renders paler still), so the fix is a runtime tint or a bronze shared set, outside this generator.
The keyhole core's hot centre stays saturated yellow rather than white-hot. In the EEVEE compare the keyhole reads close to a round disc with a short tail; the shape is clearer in the engine shots.
The pauldrons are still smooth domes with one engraved ring and three rivets, beside the concept's layered pauldrons.
Engraved panel lines and rivets are geometry and read at compare scale, but at play distance they are faint, and the brushed streak texture still looks stretched on the skirt.
Orbit band placement is unchanged: from the side it swings about 0.4 m in front of the chest, where the concept's side view keeps it behind the shoulders.
In the death pose the folded orbit band still intersects the halo rings on the floor.
authorSelfScore.method: Author self-score on the reviewer's rubric: silhouette and proportions 24/30, signature features 23/25, surface detail and material read 13/20, colour and value 12/15, readability at play distance 9/10. Judged from orrery-warden.fidelity-compare.jpg (orthographic EEVEE renders of the low-poly model at the concept's front, side and back angles, framed at the concept's own scale, 2.70 m over the crop height) side by side and in zoomed crops of the chest, core, legs and feet, plus the six in-engine shots in staging/engine, which now render the warden-glow slot through the runtime D11 glow (writeGlowIslands and applyGlowLook from src/enemies/glow.ts). glow-close is the seat camera at the 50 degree lens of docs/verification/p6-glow-orrery-warden.jpg and matched the previous committed still at a mean difference of 1.02/255 before this build. Silhouette: the lower legs are now slim calf lofts under two tapered greave lames with a front ridge, a knee cop and ankle cops, ending in pointed sabatons with three instep lames, a heel cup and a gunmetal sole. The box-palm hands are replaced by lofted gauntlets with a back plate, a knuckle bar, four three-segment fingers with dark joints and a two-segment thumb. The pauldrons are still domes and the orbit band still swings in front of the chest from the side. Signature: the round core disc is replaced by a keyhole (a ring over a tapering slot in a brass frame) with a glow channel running down the abdomen, and the head carries a raised brow plate and gunmetal cheek recesses. Surface: engraved grooves and riveted strips on the pectorals, pauldrons, vambraces and greaves are geometry (the GLB must stay image-free and the brass slot takes the shared set's normal map, so no normal-map bake). They read at compare scale but are subtle at play distance. Colour: the glow keeps the reviewer's measured amber. The brass is unchanged because the slot is replaced at runtime by the shared brass-polished set, so no generator-side lever moves its hue. In the engine glow-close shot the skirt median is (128,100,63) against the concept's (131,93,63): value matches, but the hue is yellower and the highlights go pale.

independentScore.scorer: independent reviewer agent (separate from the authoring agent; did not build the model)

rubric.note: Geometry is unchanged since d291e3c and the shape findings re-confirm on crops of the fidelity compare. Front outline is right: two halo rings, the tilted orbit band, the long tasset skirt, pointed segmented sabatons and fingered gauntlets. The greaves are still two stacked straight cylinders with a stepped width change, where the concept greave swells at the calf, tapers smoothly to the ankle and carries knee cops. The side view still shows a thin torso column without the concept's chest depth, a round egg head, dome pauldrons, and the orbit band swinging in front of the chest where the concept keeps it behind the shoulders.

All signature parts are present and unchanged: two halo rings, the orbit band with ruby, sapphire and emerald planets, shoulder jewels, the eclipse disc and the sun core with its lit channel down the abdomen. The core is still a large round disc rather than the concept's small keyhole in a ribbed bezel, and the eyes are large round goggle lenses in an egg head rather than narrow slits in an elongated skull mask with a raised brow plate.

In the dark studio engine shots the darker tint helps a little: the brushed streaks on the skirt are less washed out and the gunmetal strips read dark, (79,67,60) median on the skirt centre strip against the concept undersuit (81,67,65). The in-room shot (ingame-tint033.jpg, new evidence the previous review did not use) shows a material fault: the same gunmetal strips render as neutral pale silver, median (121,122,121) on the skirt centre strip, the same in the untinted frame. With the brass now darker, these silver strips are the brightest non-glow value on the lower body (luminance about 122 against the brass skirt's 42), which inverts the concept's and the art bible's 'polished brass plates over dark gunmetal joints' value order and makes the waist band, skirt borders and vambrace bands read as polished steel. The cuirass and pauldrons stay largely smooth, the skirt streak texture still swirls, and the engraved grooves read as thin dark slits at play distance.

Measured as sRGB with Pillow and NumPy, warm-metal pixel mask, glow excluded. Concept references, re-sampled at native resolution: left chest plate box (440,290)-(480,380) median (112,70,45), hue 22, lightness 0.31; left skirt panel (410,540)-(480,750) median (108,77,55), hue 25, L 0.32, saturation 0.33, 90th-percentile highlight (202,159,103); whole front body (101,68,49), hue 22, L 0.29. The previous review's concept chest (70,55,41), which the tint commit targeted, is a darker shadowed sample than these plate medians. Engine p6-glow-orrery-warden.jpg after the tint: whole body (74,52,30), hue 30, L 0.20, saturation 0.42; left chest box (424,165)-(442,215) (84,53,25), hue 28, L 0.21; left skirt (395,340)-(440,540) (64,40,16), hue 30, L 0.16, saturation 0.60. So the tint [0.33,0.3,0.3] is almost neutral: it mostly darkened the brass rather than turning it bronze. Hue moved from 36 to 30 deg against the concept's 22 to 25, value overshot from too light to too dark (L 0.20 against 0.29), and blue is crushed (16 to 30 against the concept's 45 to 55), so the metal is over-saturated. Real gain: the lateral skirt highlight is now bronze (182,144,101) against the concept's (202,159,103), replacing the cream. The front centre skirt panel highlight is still cream (232,207,172). Core warm median (244,168,68) against the concept (247,165,56), centre 9x9 (250,216,83) still saturated yellow rather than the concept's near-white peak (255,252,198). Eyes (240,186,79). Planets keep correct jewel tones. Net: roughly level with the previous 12.

Studio engine shots (idle, attack, hit, frozen, death) read as before: the core is the brightest saturated point and the halo and planets set the Warden apart. In the room (ingame-tint033.jpg against ingame-notint.jpg, same camera, identical background statistics) the tint is mixed. It helps against the floor and corridor: skirt luminance 42 against about 83, where the untinted skirt was 64, so the lower body silhouettes darker; and the brass no longer sits at the value of the gold damask motifs (165,117,85). It hurts against the wainscot and wallpaper directly behind the skirt: luminance 42 against 45 right of the skirt (78,38,22), near zero value contrast where the untinted skirt had 64 against 45. Only the hue gap (32 deg against 17) and the silver strips now separate that edge. Independent of the tint, the core in the room renders as a dim amber disc, about (145,110,35), well below the brass speculars (224,199,145), so it is no longer the focal point the art bible asks for. At the seated framing the head and halo are cropped off the top of the frame.

topFixes: Fix the gunmetal slot's in-room read: under the room lighting the gunmetal strips render as neutral silver (121,122,121) where the concept and the art bible want dark warm gunmetal (concept undersuit (81,67,65), bible warm black #231D1A). Darken and warm that slot (or tint it like the brass) so the plates-over-dark-joints value order returns, and restore the core as the room's focal point by raising its in-room emissive so it outshines the brass speculars.

Re-aim the brass tint at the concept's bronze rather than just darker: lift value back toward L 0.29 (whole-body median near (101,68,49)) and shift hue to 22 to 25 deg by keeping more blue and less green, for example a multiplier with red clearly above green and blue rather than the near-neutral [0.33,0.3,0.3], and tame the remaining cream highlight on the front centre skirt panel. This also restores value separation against the wainscot (luminance 45).

Rebuild the side profile, head and lower legs: chest depth with layered pauldrons, the orbit band behind the shoulders, an elongated skull mask with narrow eye slits and a raised brow plate, a smaller keyhole core in a ribbed bezel, and greaves that swell at the calf and taper to the ankle with knee cops.
independentScore.method: Re-score of build 0b97941 (brass slot tinted [0.33,0.3,0.3] in the manifest; geometry unchanged from d291e3c) with the same five-criterion rubric, re-measuring rather than inheriting. Shape was re-checked on Pillow crops of the fidelity compare (concept and model side panels, heads, lower legs) and the in-engine state shots. Colour was measured as sRGB with Pillow and NumPy on the engine shot p6-glow-orrery-warden.jpg and idle.jpg and on the in-room frames: medians, HLS hue, lightness and saturation, and 90th and 10th luminance-percentile means over a warm-metal mask (max channel over 35, R over B plus 12, core glow excluded), with explicit pixel boxes stated in the rubric notes. The concept was re-sampled at native resolution on the lit chest plate, skirt panel and whole front body, giving lighter references than the previous review's (70,55,41). In-room readability compared the tinted frame ingame-tint033.jpg against the untinted ingame-notint.jpg (same camera: identical background statistics) for skirt, arm, chest, gunmetal strip, core, wainscot, wallpaper motif and floor regions; ingame-compare033.jpg was viewed as the side-by-side. The art bible palette (polished brass #DEC16A, warm black #231D1A for gunmetal joints, one amber core as focal point) was used as a secondary check; fidelity is scored against the concept. glow-close.jpg and p6-glow-orrery-warden.jpg again share a sha256, so they are one shot. The drop from 81 comes mainly from in-room evidence the previous review did not use (silver gunmetal, dim core, wainscot value merge), not from a regression the tint introduced alone.
